thread:
maria: Seeing canary healthcheck noise on inference-service-canary, ~25% 5xx over last 2m. Noted right after wave-2 rollout started.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 5xx rate >20% for inference-service-canary (env=wave-2). Trigger: healthcheck_fail_rate.
maria: paging kevin and leo, can we confirm if this is infra or model-related? @kevin @leo
kevin: on it, looking at logs now. If it's probe timeout we might have transient backend saturation from increased batch sizes during rollout.
leo: I see the same in telemetry — p95 latency for the canary increased from 120ms -> 700ms around the rollout start. KV cache miss rate spiked.
maria: OK hold the rollout. Does we have an immediate abort flag for the rollout? I don't want this to widen.
leo: There's a safety flag: feature_flag("canary_wave_2_enabled") — I can flip to false. That should stop new canary traffic.
maria: Do it. Also set routing fallback to stable model.
leo: Running: ```/ff toggle canary_wave_2_enabled false``` -> done. Routing policy reverted to stable. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: ACTION: Feature flag canary_wave_2_enabled set to false by leo. Traffic => stable-model variant.
kevin: I'm pulling pod logs. Seeing repeated KVCacheEvict errors and OOM-kernel warnings on canary instances. Could be a quantized model memory regression.
maria: Any customer-facing 5xx spikes? @anya can you check support queue?
anya: Quick look: three customer tickets from EU about timeouts in last 10m, low severity but could grow. No major outages reported yet.
kevin: Initiating rollback for the canary image to v2.3 -> v2.1 (previous). ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-canary --to-revision=2``` Executed.
maria: Confirmed rollback started. Keep monitoring metrics. If 5xx doesn't drop in 3m, escalate to full abort and spin up extra stable capacity.
leo: Metrics: 5xx dropping to 8% after flag flip + rollback in progress. p95 latency trending down but KV miss still elevated on a couple hosts.
kevin: I'll drain the two affected nodes and reattach after garbage-collect and kernel params tweak. Taking the pager for remediation tasks.
maria: Thanks. @anya please update CS: small customer impact, transient timeouts, mitigation in progress, ETA 15-30m. Use runbook snippet below.
anya: Sending note now. "We observed elevated timeouts for a subset of requests during a canary rollout. Engineers have disabled the canary wave and rolled back the canary image. We're monitoring and will follow up within 30 minutes."
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation actions applied: feature flag disable, canary rollback, node remediation. Current status: partial recovery.
kevin: Handing off to oncoming oncall at 10:30 for watch — I'll add remediation steps to the channel. @maria you can hand off the post-rollback verification.
maria: Will do. Next oncall: @kevin (watching) -> @leo (followup) if anything reappears. Closing immediate pager loop but keeping thread open for 30m.
leo: Postmortem note: hypothesis = quantized model change increased KV cache pressure leading to latency and 5xx. Will add a canary resource guard to limit concurrent batch size next rollout.
maria: Good. After 30m if stable, we'll mark this as resolved and open a minor incident with follow-up tasks. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
